t: You're on Prince Consort Road in South Kensington, which runs between Queen's Gate to the west and Exhibition Road to the east, parallel to Kensington Gore. The name honours Prince Albert, husband of Queen Victoria. He was consort of the monarch from their marriage on 10 February 1840 until his death in 1861, and Victoria granted him the title Prince Consort in 1857. So the street is named for that title, and the road carries it still.
